title: Game modes - House of Pips Wiki
description: Every House of Pips game mode, its target score and hand size, how to unlock it, and the Custom mode modifiers.
html:
Game modes

The Modes screen chooses which ruleset the Play button starts. A new career has Classic Table; every other mode unlocks by completing the career trials printed on its card.

The modes #

ModeTargetBones per handIn the gameHow to unlock
Classic Table1507The original race to 150 with seven bones and standard perk drafts.Available from the start
Old School1507Seven bones, first to 150, and nothing but traditional dominoes.Complete Nana's tutorial
All In2007Every draft gives you both perks and the malus. No folding.Finish 2 matches; Take every draft card twice; Acquire 10 total perks
Quick Draw755Five-bone hands and a sharp race to 75. Every decision lands faster.Call 15 Fivers; Complete 20 hands
The Long Haul4007Race to 400. The hand loser receives two consecutive perk drafts.Win 3 matches; Earn 2,000 points; Win 30 hands
House of Malice2007Both players open with two random maluses already haunting their rack.Acquire 10 maluses; Lose 50 points to maluses; Finish 3 matches
Custom1507Build the table rules, hand size, target, and rival yourself.Win Classic; Win All In; Win Quick Draw; Win The Long Haul; Win House of Malice; Win Legendary Table; Win Old School
Legendary Table2507Every draft reveals three legendary perks. Choose exactly one each time.Unlock all legendary perks; Win 5 matches

A few notes on the rules above:

  • Old School is traditional dominoes: no perks, no skills and no supplies. It unlocks as soon as you finish Nana's tutorial.
  • All In gives you every card in every draft, Malus included, so builds grow fast in both directions.
  • Quick Draw deals five-bone hands, so hands end quickly. Its unlock trial "Call 15 Fivers" counts plays that score exactly 5 points.
  • The Long Haul gives the loser of each hand two drafts in a row.
  • House of Malice starts both players with two random maluses.
  • Legendary Table offers three legendary perks in every draft, with no Malus. Its trials ask you to unlock every legendary perk first.
  • Custom appears once you have won a match in every other mode on the list.

Custom mode #

Custom lets you set:

  • Bones in each hand, from 5 to 10.
  • Scoring target, from 50 to 500 in steps of 25.
  • Rival's strategy and skill level. See Rival and table styles.
  • Any mix of match modifiers:
ModifierEffect
All InEvery draft gives both perks and the malus.
Double DownThe hand loser receives two consecutive perk drafts.
House of MaliceBoth players open with two random maluses.
Legendary TableDrafts reveal two legendary perks and one malus.
Full HouseEvery perk is available to both players' drafts.
Old SchoolNo perks, skills, or consumables; disables every other modifier.

Choose Use this custom mode, then Play starts your custom table.

Modes online #

Online matches use the same rulesets, with a few differences such as equal loadouts for both players. See Online play.
